Name: Custom Warp Locations
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Custom Warp Locations[/size]
[size=3]
This mod lets you change where your warp totems, obelisks, and return scepter warp you to!

Press the activation key (default f5, can be changed in the config) to set the new warp location to where [u]you're currently standing[/u] based on the item [u]you're currently holding[/u]. There are two modes. Advanced mode is set off by default, but you can enable it in the config.[/size]

[size=5]Advanced Mode Off:[/size]
[list]
[*]Warp Totem: Farm -> Warp Totem: Farm location
[*]Return Scepter -> Return Scepter Location
[*]Warp Totem: Mountains -> Warp Totem: Mountains location AND Earth Obelisk location
[*]Warp Totem: Beach -> Warp totem: Beach location AND Water Obelisk location
[*]Earth Crystal -> Warp Totem: Mountains location AND Earth Obelisk location
[*]Clam -> Warp totem: Beach location AND Water Obelisk location
[/list]
[size=5]Advanced Mode On:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Warp Totem: Farm -> Warp Totem: Farm location[/size]
[*][size=2]Return Scepter -> Return Scepter Location[/size]
[*][size=2]Warp Totem: Mountains -> Warp Totem: Mountains location[/size]
[*][size=2]Warp Totem: Beach -> Warp totem: Beach location[/size]
[*][size=2]Earth Crystal ->Earth Obelisk location[/size]
[*][size=2]Clam -> Water Obelisk location[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][b]TLDR[/b][/size][size=3]: Basically, in simple mode your Warp Totem: Mountains and Earth Obelisk take you to the same place and your Warp Totem: Beach and Water Obelisk take you to the same place. In advanced mode they can take you to different places. Regardless of mode, your Warp Totem: Farm and Return Scepter take you to different locations.[/size]

[size=5][b]TLDR #2[/b][/size][size=3]: To set the new location of an item, walk to where you want it to warp you, hold the item, and press f5. In advanced mode to set the Earth Obelisk location use an Earth Crystal and to set the Water Obelisk location use a Clam.

[u]After setting a new location, use the item like normal and it will take you to that place![/u] If you haven't set a new warp location, you'll be taken to the default game's warp location for that item.

This mod requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url] by PathosChild. To install, place the CustomWarpLocations folder inside of your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

**When updating this mod, don't delete the Data folder inside of the CustomWarpLocations folder. This holds your custom warp positions and if deleted they'll be reset to normal!**

Note that you can't warp to indoor locations - you can only warp to outside places. If something is not working properly feel free to let me know :).

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url][/size]

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install. Requires SMAPI v.2.9+. Don't delete the Data folder inside the Custom Warp Locations folder.
